pages.text: A Radiant Resonator produces a cluster of Raw Radiant Quartz in the block above itself once every five minutes. Once Quartz is produced, the process halts until the block above the Resonator is cleared.$(br2)You can only place up to three Radiant Resonators. Any further Resonators you attempt to place will pop off, and any Resonators placed by automated means will destroy themselves.

Radiant Resonators only run while you’re online, even if the chunk is loaded.$(br2)Using a $(l:arcanearchives:items/scepterrevelation)Scepter of Revelation$(/l) on a Radiant Resonator will return its current process, and whether it is running or not.

When monitored with a Redstone Comparator, a Radiant Resonator ouptuts a signal based on its progress towards creating a new $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/rawquartzcluster)Radiant Quartz Cluster$(/l).$(br2)Radiant Resonators can be crafted conventionally.
